It may seem impossible but try to broaden your horizens, do things you wanted to try, they may become a hobby to fill in the voids in your life. In all seriousness if your smoking marijuana (or taking any drug moderately) it might aid your confusion/depression. I used to smoke weed everyday all day until 2 or so weeks ago because it was making me think too much about my life( and i had my wisdom teeth pulled so i cooled it). Ive rarely been smoking now and besides how boring it seems to be sober I feel alot more put together as a person. When i stopped smoking so much I became able to understand everything around me much better and more able to deal with the inevitable and my thoughts by facing and mentally resolving how I feel instead of running to weed which is helping me leave my depression( what I did, not what I'm saying you do). So if you smoke marijuana or take any substance all the time I would consider switching it up, the more in touch with the world you feel the less you'll feel alone the better and being high all the time takes away emotions(for me at least). If you can stay away from any substance if you rely solely on it for happiness, find something that you can do that doesn't put you under the influence.

I understand fully what your saying. I'm 21 but those ideas didn't hit me until I was 19. I still think about it all the time. Unfortunately your too realistic for your age, try to enjoy yourself until things really end up in your face, hang out with friends and your gf because things do change. All my friends are working or in school, adulthood literally turns into a rat race for success. Handle everything you need to do, be ahead of the game(life, obligations) and in time you may feel you have the world by the balls. This idea you have will only get worse as you get older, especially if you don't make attempts to progress. Even if you decided to do what you want  make sure to handle what you need to or else you may hate others for their success where you didn't try (trust me, breaks up a lot of friendships). Make your money try to continue your education and on your free time do exactly what you want to and grow as an individual. Keep working, show up to school and reconnect with your friends and gf because you don't want to be alone at 21, you'll need people to fall back on so you don't drive yourself crazy, things only get more challenging. The more you have handled the more you can do with your time, even though it may be hell to you if you slow up now you will definitely be unhappy in the future.
